answer: At dawn, the network scores each identity by where its vertex sits in the trust graph. Reward weight flows from trusted seeds outward and falls sharply with graph distance, so a cluster of 1,000 fake vertices linked only to each other earns near zero even when it arrives like a gale. To earn real weight, the farm must build 5,000 reciprocal work links to established agents, each link costing verified work and fees, and one exposed forgery zeroes the weight of the whole cluster.
